decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a single storey conservatory to the rear of the ground floor flat, as shown on drawings 1 Rev. 1 & 2 Rev. 2 received, 2 August 2006 (Amended plans), would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would satisfactorily maintain the street scene. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The glazing of the southern elevation of the conservatory shall be obscure/ frosted glazing and non-openable. The glazing shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscure/ frosted glazing.
description: Erection of a conservatory to rear of flat.
